name: Empowered Bloodmoon (3-4)
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-05: Silver Bark, Golden Blades
description: Bloodmoon is a naginata that can act on its own provided it is attuned to at least one creature.
disable: Two successful DC 20 Religion check or DC 20 Occultism checks, Dispel Magic (2nd rank; counteract DC 18)
routine: (3 actions) Bloodmoon uses its first action to fly up to 20 feet towards an opponent. It then makes two naginata strikes, each against a different foe.

offensiveAbilities.name: Float
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger Combat begins with the creature it is attuned to

Effect The blade begins to float in the air, then rolls initiative.

offensiveAbilities.name: Prone to Monologuing
offensiveAbilities.description: If a PC uses an action to taunt Bloodmoon with a successful DC 18 Deception check, DC 18 Diplomacy check, or DC 18 Intimidation check, Bloodmoon must spend an action monologuing on the next turn.

offensiveAbilities.name: Tiny
offensiveAbilities.description: Bloodmoon is treated as a tiny creature with reach.
